intended: all f: Fence, u: Unit | f->u in Within.rel implies (no v: Unit | u->v in Sit.rel and v->f in Blocks.rel)
why: The rationale says the unit above (the parent that u sits in) must not claim the fence, but the formula quantifies over v with v->u in Sit.rel (v sitting in u, i.e. a child of u) instead of u->v in Sit.rel (u sitting in v, i.e. v the parent of u). E.g. if A sits in B and fence f lies within A's own text, the author intends that B must not be read as owning f; the written formula only forbids children of A from owning f and says nothing about B, so it misses exactly the case the rationale describes.
